name: University of Zurich
description: The University of Zurich is a public university in Zurich, founded in 1833. With about 28,000 students it is Switzerland's largest university.
whyIncluded: Its medical degree is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications, it is Switzerland's largest university, and Switzerland is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 280 in UNESCO UIS data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: UZH Student Financial Aid Office 'General estimates (minimal costs per month)': housing (rent, heating, energy) CHF 910; food CHF 450; travel CHF 95; personal (clothing, hygiene, leisure, phone) CHF 270. Excludes the study line (CHF 250, which includes tuition), insurance/AHV (CHF 200) and tax reserve (CHF 25). UZH's own minimum total is CHF 2,200 a month and it warns international students face extra costs. Page undated; read September 2026.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Informatics
programmes.notes: Tuition CHF 720 per semester + CHF 500 surcharge for foreign students at bachelor level = CHF 1,220 x 2. Mandatory semester contributions CHF 59 x 2 (scholarship fund, libraries, ASVZ sports, student concerns). One-off application fee CHF 150 for applicants with foreign qualifications (non-refundable). 3-year (180 ECTS) bachelor's taught in German. Fee page is undated; rates read September 2026.
